newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba will continue to review rate policy - Tietmeyer.
newsitem.headline: Buba will continue to review rate policy - Tietmeyer.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said on Thursday that he believed central bank rates were currently appropriate but added that the central bank would review the position every two weeks, as usual.
Tietmeyer told reporters in Bonn "For now, I consider that they (interest rates) are appropriate, but we will continue to examine this."

He added that there could be a further easing in long-term rates, over which the Bundesbank has no direct control, but this would depend on the financial markets continuing to have confidence that inflation would be kept low.
"The more the impression grows that European monetary union will be based on price stability, the greater the chances of a further reduction in capital market rates," he said.
